test_title: PYST 62: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

ND – RH – VL

LB – PF – TJ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f9b4fb33322af8aa90f5ac7cb67f9863b2f729a42c2b1de8e486dd4d43ee3f9.png] 

Logic followed here is: In each triad, the first letter of each pair increases by 4 to get the first letter of the next pair, and the second letter of each pair increases by 4 to get the second letter of the next pair.

**For ND – RH – VL →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3145c34fbd36e8516f094617bc11d2e33cf285ee12fbb45cf23889a450483bae.png] 

 

**For LB – PF – TJ →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd34496587692ba606447456dcc6def7b0d0169f55d1d4a10a3cdd911abef23c.png] 

 

**Similarly, Option 3) QG – UK – YO:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/072e4fbdefc136d9c71a2530ad4b0473d1e0226001907acdcefc207588388908.png] 

Therefore, the triad 'QG – UK – YO' follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
